history.target_scope: 2013Q3 onward, post-spin company reporting; no chart digitization
history.target: Retail fuel margin, excluding supply/RIN and payment fees where disclosed
history.reconciliation: Reported retail fuel contribution divided by reported retail gallons within rounding tolerance
history.old_history_use: Separate expanding-window old-history model for earlier regime; frozen existing 2019-start production model retained for later regime, not blind pooling
history.source_gaps: Explicitly blocked; no quarterly outcomes inferred from annual averages

floor.hypothesis: Previously reported retailer cost and volume pressure can shift required pricing economics
floor.proxy_scope: MUSA own disclosed station operating cost, not competitors or industry wage measurement
floor.feature_basis: One consistent station-operating-expense total divided by chain gallons; cost/volume proxy only, never add expense to gross margin mechanically
floor.no_negative_sss_assumption: Use signed negative growth feature, not a clipped posthoc threshold

fuel_basis.geographic_weights: Existing frozen weights.csv; no optimized regional weights
fuel_basis.diesel_wholesale_substitution: FORBIDDEN gasoline spot not labelled diesel acquisition cost

evaluation: Matched expanding-window rows, reported separately by regime; fixed existing promotion gate and recent8; no adaptive feature selection
promotion: NOT_AUTOMATIC even if historical gate passes; previously mined history is developmental
